values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com (Eleven Mile State Park listing, loop Howbert Point) or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead; a vehicle pass must be displayed. note: Small drive-in loop on a peninsula jutting into Eleven Mile Reservoir, ~8,590 ft; open sites with water on three sides. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + cpwshop per-site pages: confirmed 10 sites (701-710, basic, 50-80 ft, 2 pull-throughs), no electric (and no water/sewer), reservation-only on cpwshop; added seasonal (closes Nov 1), url/window 180/fcfs never/14-night max. Fees ($28) and facilities left as stored. Note: dropped the site-count/amenity/booking restatements and 'Camp Colorado'.
flags: Waterfront (stored lakefront): cpwshop tags all 10 Howbert Point sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront'. On Esri imagery the loop fills the tip of a peninsula with open ground, site points ~25-70 m from the waterline in that image; pool level unknown. No contrary claim.
Pin 38.9196,-105.5161 is at the loop entrance, 73 m from the 10-site centroid (38.91994,-105.51537).
Season: the CPW page gives only the November 1 closing for Howbert Point, no opening date.
